subject: Daz
fact: Daz overhears Thorin telepathically asking if Flumph will join them. Flumph says, 'I want to observe a tragedy, not be in one. I will stay here.'
source_quote: Flumph says, 'I want to observe a tragedy, not be in one. I will stay here.'

subject: Rust
fact: Rust turns to Jimjar and says, 'Only these four will come, the rest of you,' pointing at Spiderbait, Jimjar, Sarith, Stool and Eldeth, 'can wait here.'
source_quote: Only these four will come, the rest of you, pointing at Spiderbait, Jimjar, Sarith, Stool and Eldeth, can wait here.

subject: assassin’s cave
fact: Rust marches them into a cave that is 70 feet long and 70 feet wide at its widest point. Inside is a large garden. Standing in the garden is Duergar with an eye patch.
source_quote: Rust marches them into a cave that is 70 feet long and 70 feet wide at its widest point. Inside is a large garden. Standing in the garden is Duergar with an eye patch.

subject: desk with papers
fact: Daz takes note of a desk to the north with papers. He also notices three soul blades, the name the Duergar assassins give themselves, standing behind what appears to be their boss.
source_quote: Daz takes note of a desk to the north with papers. He also notices three soul blades, the name the Duergar assassins give themselves, standing behind what appears to be their boss.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: The Duergar with an eye patch speaks, 'My name is Eldgrim. Rust says you may have a deal for us. And in exchange, we are to let you through our territory.'
source_quote: My name is Eldgrim. Rust says you may have a deal for us. And in exchange, we are to let you through our territory.

subject: contract with seal
fact: Thorin reads the contract: 'Faster this time. Faster! I want to hear heads rolling by the time the ink dries on the tip of my quill! Or veins bursting black with poison, or lungs filling with water, or faces melting in forges… I don’t care how you do it, just do it faster! THARGUS IRONHEAD!!!!! HOW DARE HE TRY TO ENCROACH ON MY FAMILY’S BUSINESS???? BOIL HIM! BOIL HIM IN OIL AND FEED HIM TO ROACHES! WERZ SALTBARON THAT SNIVELING SQUEALING WRITHING LITTLE RAT! BIND HIS FEET AND THROW HIM OFF HIS BELOVED DOCKS! Captain Blackskull… I’ve smelled treason on her since she was but a lass. She’s always had an eye on my throne, but she’ll never get it! All she’ll get is what’s coming to her. Yes, that’s what she’ll get! His Arrogance, His Rotundity… the Pampered, the Portly, the Scheming Red… Freeze the Wyrmsmith until his heart turns crystalline, then smash it to bits! LINGRICK XARDELVAR MY MOST GASEOUS ALLY!!!!!!'

subject: seal of the Deepking and royal seal of Gracklstugh
fact: Thorin points to a mark on the document bearing the personal seal of the Deepking and the royal seal of Gracklstugh.
source_quote: a mark on the document bearing the personal seal of the Deepking and the royal seal of Gracklstugh

subject: larger tunnel and cavern
fact: Past the caves they sneaked through, is a much larger tunnel, some 80 feet wide and hundreds of feet long. To the west, the tunnel opens up into a massive cave, glowing with faerzress, bioluminescent fungi, and shafts of white light that fall. Getting closer, he sees naturally formed shelves along the walls as well as a rocky mesa at the center of the cavern. His eye is drawn to crudely formed ramps connecting the different levels of the mesa up to the height of its two topmost tiers, which are linked by a sturdy bridge.

subject: large red egg
fact: Atop one of those tiers sits a large red egg.
source_quote: Atop one of those tiers sits a large red egg.

subject: 50-foot-tall obelisk
fact: There stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk made of smooth black metal with a few noticeable imperfections, as though small parts of it were somehow chipped away.
source_quote: There stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk made of smooth black metal with a few noticeable imperfections, as though small parts of it were somehow chipped away.

subject: female derro
fact: A female derro stands close to the obelisk, gently patting and stroking its surface. The obelisk flashes once, the glow of faerzress around the cavern flaring in response. The derro squeals with glee as she snatches an object up from the ground, then writes something down in a small notebook.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir proposes a new plan: 'I will cover you in Darkness and you will just be quiet.'
source_quote: I will cover you in Darkness and you will just be quiet.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin turns to Flumph, Jimjar, Sarith, Stool, Eldeth, and Spiderbait and commands them to be quiet. He demonstrates by walking on his tip toes.
source_quote: Thorin turns to Flumph, Jimjar, Sarith, Stool, Eldeth, and Spiderbait and commands them to be quiet. He demonstrates by walking on his tip toes.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mutters, 'The egg.' Atop one of those tiers sits a large red egg. 'The obelix,' he notes when he looks atop the other tier. There stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk made of smooth black metal with a few noticeable imperfections, as though small parts of it were somehow chipped away.
source_quote: The egg. Atop one of those tiers sits a large red egg. The obelix, he notes when he looks atop the other tier. There stands a 50-foot-tall obelisk made of smooth black metal with a few noticeable imperfections, as though small parts of it were somehow chipped away.

subject: Raucus Mesa
fact: He then follows the path towards the Raucus Mesa.
source_quote: He then follows the path towards the Raucus Mesa.

subject: Derro slums of Gracklstugh
fact: Daz looks at Flumph, Jimjar, Sarith, Stool, Eldeth, and Spiderbait, armed with Errde’s weapons. 'Perhaps they will help us' as they follow him, Zalthir, Grygum, and Thorin, into the Derro slums of Gracklstugh.

subject: Grimgrim
fact: Two Derro materialise. They introduce themselves as Grimgrim and some unpronounceable Derro.
source_quote: Two Derro materialise. They introduce themselves as Grimgrim and some unpronounceable Derro.

subject: Rust
fact: The Drow not named Grimgrim explains that he can be called — 'Rust.'
source_quote: The Drow not named Grimgrim explains that he can be called — 'Rust.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin blurts out, 'Are you the assassins or the dudes trying to become besties with Demogorgon?'
source_quote: Are you the assassins or the dudes trying to become besties with Demogorgon?

subject: Rust
fact: Rust speaks in a serious tone, 'Yes. We are the empty scabbard killers.'
source_quote: Yes. We are the empty scabbard killers.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir, who learned the art of saying little, wonders if he can rip Thorin’s throat out when the dwarf asks, 'How do you kill people if you have an empty scabbard?'
source_quote: Zalthir, who learned the art of saying little, wonders if he can rip Thorin’s throat out when the dwarf asks, 'How do you kill people if you have an empty scabbard?'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'Well, it's easier to kill someone if the scabbard is empty?'
source_quote: Well, it's easier to kill someone if the scabbard is empty?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks, 'Oh, is it because you have your weapon in your hand, or is it magical?'
source_quote: Oh, is it because you have your weapon in your hand, or is it magical?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir remembers that they had to help Werz. What Werz wants is not to be a target. Killing the assassins is not what he wants.
source_quote: Zalthir remembers that they had to help Werz. What Werz wants is not to be a target. Killing the assassins is not what he wants.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz whispers through the telepathy of Stool, 'I like the idea of collecting all of the information and then distributing it to all of the power brokers of Gracklstugh simultaneously. We could stab them all in the front simultaneously and flee in the chaos.'
source_quote: I like the idea of collecting all of the information and then distributing it to all of the power brokers of Gracklstugh simultaneously. We could stab them all in the front simultaneously and flee in the chaos.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin turns to Rust and Grim, 'Hey, we would love to compare notes on the cult of Demogorgon and see if we can help each other out.'
source_quote: Hey, we would love to compare notes on the cult of Demogorgon and see if we can help each other out.

subject: Rust
fact: Rust shouts, 'Let me confer with my leadership to see if they agree with this plan.'
source_quote: Let me confer with my leadership to see if they agree with this plan.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim laughs, 'Small potatoes. I can cancel the contract for a small fee and permanently brightlist him for a small fee.'
source_quote: Small potatoes. I can cancel the contract for a small fee and permanently brightlist him for a small fee.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim says, 'The legend of our guild will spread far and wide.' The other duergar looks at him oddly, and he says, 'And if you spread anything but our legend, well then, perhaps we will have to take care of a certain author.'
source_quote: The legend of our guild will spread far and wide. The other duergar looks at him oddly, and he says, 'And if you spread anything but our legend, well then, perhaps we will have to take care of a certain author.'

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim says, 'You want to prove we exist? Do you want to show this contract to someone, and do you really think they will believe that we exist and not think it's a forgery? You’re a fool. Anyone who sees any proof of our existence and knows we exist will deny our existence, and everyone else will laugh at your credulity.'
source_quote: You want to prove we exist? Do you want to show this contract to someone, and do you really think they will believe that we exist and not think it's a forgery? You’re a fool. Anyone who sees any proof of our existence and knows we exist will deny our existence, and everyone else will laugh at your credulity.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim says, 'As if a group of strangers can come down here and find proof of something that nobody has found, ever.'
source_quote: As if a group of strangers can come down here and find proof of something that nobody has found, ever.

subject: Eldgrim
fact: Eldgrim says, 'Now go get rid of my problem.' He pauses, 'And if you don’t, then you will die. It will be a free contract that I will enjoy fulfilling.'
source_quote: Now go get rid of my problem. And if you don’t, then you will die. It will be a free contract that I will enjoy fulfilling.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'I learned about contracts. The Giants needed somebody to make deals with the locals, and I made contracts. It’s easy to make a good contract if the choice is a contract or a bunch of giants raid your town.'
source_quote: I learned about contracts. The Giants needed somebody to make deals with the locals, and I made contracts. It’s easy to make a good contract if the choice is a contract or a bunch of giants raid your town.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'I think we have what we need.'
source_quote: I think we have what we need.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz mutters, 'Yes, we do.'
source_quote: Yes, we do.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin smiles. He’s seen many contracts that people should never have signed. He never wrote those.
